mentions.name: WireWiki
mentions.description: A browsable map of internet infrastructure that goes beyond standalone lookup tools by interlinking results, letting users navigate between related assets such as DNS records, SPF records, mail providers, and IP address details.
mentions.problem: Existing lookup tools return isolated results instead of showing how internet infrastructure assets connect to each other.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://www.wirewiki.com.

A browsable map of internet infrastructure. Not just a collection of lookup tools, but it also interlinks results, so you can navigate linked assets as well. Think: DNS lookup -> SPF record -> mail provider's SPF record -> IP address details.
